title: HalluScore: Large Language Model Hallucination Question Answering Benchmark
reasoning: The HalluScore benchmark includes 'Religion' as one of its core knowledge domains (comprising 7.9% of the dataset) and incorporates a 'Stereotypes' question category. It evaluates LLMs on their accuracy regarding religious history, jurisprudential matters like Zakat calculations, and cultural practices, making religion and social bias significant components of the benchmark's evaluation criteria.
